messages:
maria_cs: Hey team — BridgeFlow dedicated pool go-live next Tue. Quota is set to 1200 concurrent slots, target steady QPS 350, burst headroom 700. Need autoscale policy validation, load-test window, and priming plan. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/bridgeflow-warmup :spiral_calendar:

sam_se: On it. Quick q: should KV prefix priming be 24h or 72h? If 24h we can do targeted priming during the load test window.

leila_sre: Recommend 72h given previous cold-cache latency spikes. Also plan to lower batching threshold to 16 for BridgeFlow to avoid token-level stalls.

tom_ops: I'll own the rollout window. Prefer 02:00-05:00 UTC to minimize customer impact. OK to keep burst capacity enabled for the first hour?

nora_pm: PM + customer are fine with overnight. Customer also asked for extra telemetry on token-latency percentiles (p50/p90/p99).

sam_se: Draft autoscale policy below — please review quickly:

```
min_replicas: 2
target_qps_per_replica: 75
scale_up_threshold: 0.75
scale_down_stable_window: 180s
burst_capacity: 2x
```

leila_sre: Change suggestion: target_qps_per_replica -> 60, scale_up_threshold -> 0.6, add cooldown 60s. Otherwise we risk oscillation during spikes.

maria_cs: Updated. Load test plan: 1) 5m ramp to 70% 2) 20m steady at ~350 QPS 3) 5m spike to 700 QPS 4) cooldown to 30%. We'll run 2 iterations and capture metrics.

qa-bot: Load tests scheduled: 2025-07-08T02:00:00Z and 2025-07-09T02:00:00Z. Harness: https://ci.redwood/tests/bridgeflow-warmup :robot_face:

 tom_ops: Smoke checklist items I added to runbook: health checks, KV priming progress, slot usage, error-budget watch, fallback model enabled. I linked checklist in runbook.

sam_se: KV priming command (example):

curl -X POST https://internal-priming/prime -d '{"tenant":"bridgeflow","hours":72}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $PRIME_TOKEN"

maria_cs: Who will monitor in real time? leila_sre?

leila_sre: I'll be oncall and watching latency p50/p90/p99, GPU util, and queue depth. tom_ops will watch fallback triggers and autoscale events.

nora_pm: Also will send a short customer feedback survey after cutover. Questions are in the runbook.

maria_cs: Summary / action items:
- leila_sre: apply autoscale edits (target_qps_per_replica=60, scale_up_threshold=0.6, cooldown=60s)
- sam_se: run 72h priming, share priming logs in thread
- tom_ops: confirm run window (02:00-05:00 UTC) and owner rollback plan
- nora_pm: prep customer feedback survey and post-cutover touchpoint

@everyone: please react when you ack. :white_check_mark:

sam_se: Ack :white_check_mark:

leila_sre: Ack :white_check_mark:

 tom_ops: Ack :white_check_mark:

nora_pm: Ack :white_check_mark:
